sentences.en: The work mostly consists of removing undergrowth and clearing away litter.
sentences.zh: 这项工作主要是清除矮树丛和清理垃圾。

sentences.en: The truck got stuck in the undergrowth.
The hiker had to push through thick undergrowth to reach the trail.
sentences.zh: 徒步者不得不穿过茂密的矮树丛才能到达小路。

senses.zh: 发育不全；生长在大树下的灌木；动物身上长在长毛下面的浓密绒毛
